settings.heading: How it ships
settings.text: Packed in an insulated liner with gel packs at our licensed Ventura, CA facility and handed to the carrier the same morning. Orders placed after Wednesday ship the following Monday so nothing sits in a truck over the weekend.

settings.heading: Age verification
settings.text: Every order requires an adult 21 or over to sign at delivery. Carriers will not leave beer at the door, and IDs are checked against the name on the order.

settings.heading: Fill out the box
settings.intro: Add two more packs and the shipping cost per beer drops by roughly a third.
